actual_caller: Pinned Verifiers vf-run run_episodes -> Env.run_slot -> real NullHarness subprocess -> EvalClient loopback HTTP -> EchoTask echoed reward
native_integration: An opt-in outer wrapper, without changes or monkeypatches to the upstream runner, harness, client or scorer. The original run_episodes remains callable independently for rollback.

workload.sdk_retry_scope: Actual NullHarness SDK behavior remains native; every received provider POST, including failed or refused arrivals, must be recorded. More than three provider arrivals fails acceptance.
workload.selection: Largest completed development reward; attempt key ascending tie-break. Burned reservations do not enter score denominator.
workload.fixed_denominator: One native trace and one real echoed reward per completed episode. Expected development scores 0 and 1; final fixture score 1. These are fixture correctness values, not model quality.

recovery.first_kill: After native development completion and FULL-synchronous SQLite score receipt commit, before owner acknowledgement. Completed attempt is not rerun.
recovery.second_kill: After the third development episode/scoring allowance is reserved, before native entry. On verified prior-owner death, burn it without refund or replay.
recovery.final_repeat: Reject both an exact final replay and a new final attempt; reject late development after selection.
recovery.version_control: Hash actual evaluator and runner bytes before reservations/native entry; reject a mismatched evaluator digest before changing the ledger. Bind the generated complete protocol hash and fixed limits to SQLite identity.
recovery.sealed_data_scope: Separate public fixture file, opened by the worker only after winner commit. This is logical single-owner separation; it is not hidden benchmark data or an OS/adversarial sandbox.

acceptance: All four immutable reservations survive both verified prior-process deaths; statuses completed/completed/burned/completed and rewards 0/1/null/1.
Exactly three actual native episodes, one native trace and echoed score each, and exactly three accepted provider POSTs; no failed or hidden arrival.
Version mismatch changes neither ledger nor provider count; exact replay, identity conflict, over-budget development, final repeat and late development are refused.
Winner committed before final-data read; no final observation is used to change candidates, budgets, evaluator or selection.
Three distinct worker PIDs, first two confirmed SIGKILL exits before next worker, third exit zero; all native runtime scopes closed at barriers.
No re-run or threshold/auditor repair on the same freeze. A failure remains failed. Independent saved-byte and stopped-database review precedes any acceptance claim.
required_metrics: Fixture episode and score membership/success; no model-quality claim
Completed useful native episodes divided by full suite wall time; fixed holds, process startup and restarts included
Each complete run_episodes latency, observed median and maximum/p95 convention on only three observations; full controller and host CLI scope separately
Whole-container cgroup memory.peak and sampled memory.current/pids.current at 100ms; no peak GPU claim
All HTTP request/response body bytes and hashes; excludes headers, TCP and local interception traffic
Observer read time, sample count and persisted artifact sizes; no causal observer-overhead comparison
pre_execution_requirements: Docker must be healthy and exact pinned source clean; no automatic desktop restart, GUI or purchase.

Recheck at least2147483648bytes of free host disk immediately before both package installation and harness-cache preparation, and stop on unmet floor. This is a prerequisite, not an explanation of the retained I/O failure.
Complete authentic NullHarness PEP723 dependency lock/cache, explicitly volume-nocopy on a new owned cache volume. Preserve failed20261104T074015Z copy attempt and prior Windows bind install timeout.
Freeze generated protocol with actual source/code/data/main-package-lock and harness-lock hashes after independent exact review, before any native runner/provider/score call.
Run the complete controller once under network-none using only owned inputs, with no unrelated-workspace mount.

linux_mount_contract./source: Exact clean pinned Verifiers checkout, read-only
linux_mount_contract./inputs: Generated protocol.json and completed harness.lock/packages.lock, read-only
linux_mount_contract./output: New owned isolated result directory, writable
linux_mount_contract./root/.cache: New owned Linux cache volume, explicit volume-nocopy; prepare genuine script dependencies before freezing and disable external network for the suite
linux_mount_contract.optimization: Do not use python -O: acceptance assertions must remain enabled.

limitations: All provider behavior and usage tokens are deterministic fixtures; no real model, benchmark quality, paid service, GPU, distributed or production result.
Single trusted owner; recovery requires proof the prior owner is stopped. No concurrent-owner recovery, tenant authentication, hostile code isolation or external exactly-once guarantee.
Failure-close reservations may burn work and reduce availability. No refund or automatic retry of uncertain work.
Only two fixed crash boundaries: after committed completion and before native entry. No mid-provider, mid-scoring, power-loss or arbitrary-interleaving recovery claim.
Three development reservations bound this finite workload, not general history growth, scheduling capacity or performance improvement.
H3 full closed-evaluation gate and H4 remain unmet; H1 negative results/original5GiB endpoint and all H2 failures/closed finite gates remain unchanged.
